title: 3rd Anniversary Of Local Sino-Japanese Hostilities August 13 - Observance

page_data.en:
CONFIDENTIAL

（印：SPECIAL POLICE REGISTRY 297/1 12 / / ）

Special Branch, S.M.P.
August 9, 1940.

3rd Anniversary of local Sino-Japanese hostilities
August 13 - observance

Information at present is to the effect that
the local Chinese community will refrain from conducting
any movement in commemoration of the anniversary of
August 13 in view of the unsettled situation prevailing
locally. Enquiries among public bodies, schools, and
refugee camps ascertain that they will not hold any
meetings or undertake any other form of activity. The
majority of the theatres and amusement resorts including
the Roof Gardens of the four Department Stores on
Nanking Road intend closing on August 13 as they have
done in previous years, while factories and commercial
concerns will carry on as usual.

It is learned that supporters of the Kuomintang
and other pro-National Government elements will observe
the anniversary by publishing articles of a national
salvation nature in the Chinese Press. Visits may be
made to the "Lone Battalion" on that day.

The pro-Japanese organizations which include
the Great People's Society, 22 Columbia Road and other
Japanese sponsored official organs with offices in
Nantse, Chapel and Pootung, have not as yet received
any instructions for commemorating the anniversary.

（批：签名）

上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科
1940年8月9日。

当地中日敌对行动三周年
8月13日 – 纪念活动

目前获悉，鉴于当地局势动荡，本地华人社团将 refrain from（避免）举行任何纪念“八一三”周年的活动。经向各公共团体、学校及难民营查询，证实它们不会举行任何集会或开展其他形式的活动。包括南京路四大百货公司屋顶花园在内的大多数戏院和娱乐场所，打算像往年一样在8月13日停业，而工厂和商号则将照常运营。

据悉，国民党支持者及其他拥护国民政府的分子将在中文报刊上发表救国性质的文章，以此方式纪念该周年纪念日。当天可能会有人前往探访“孤军”。

亲日组织，包括位于哥伦比亚路22号的“大民会”以及其他由日本资助、办事处设在南市、闸北和浦东的官方机构，迄今尚未收到关于纪念该周年纪念日的任何指示。

（批：签名）

*CONFIDENTIAL
August 6, 1940.

Divisional Memo No. 332.
Divisional Officers.
D.D.O's (For information)

PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES TO BE ADOPTED ON THE
ANNIVERSARY OF THE OUTBREAK OF LOCAL HOSTILITIES,
AUGUST 9/14, 1940
-------------------------

1ST STAGE

SEARCH
PARTIES
1. Commencing from 6.00 p.m. August 5th, internal
Search Parties consisting of all available uniform
officers and detectives will round up and detain
in Stations all known suspects, loiterers, persons
found in hotels, tea-shops, lodging houses etc.,
who fail to give a satisfactory account to the
Police of their presence in the Settlement.
Station staffs will be assisted by the Reserve Unit
and other details to be published later.

SUSPECTS
2. Suspects who are not charged will be released at
the discretion of Divisional Officers.

CURFEW
3. Curfew will be strictly enforced from August 8/8
until "stand-down" is ordered.

2ND STAGE

4. Precautionary measures will be put into force at
5 a.m. August 9th and will not be relaxed until
stand-down on August 14/15.

MILITARY
PATROLS
5. The cooperation of the British Military,
United States Marine Corps, the Royal Italian
Marines, the S.V.C., and the French Police, has
been requested, and the maximum number of
special patrols for internal security are being
supplied by the Military and S.V.C.

BARRICADES
6. Barricade Southern and Western Boundaries of the
Settlement.
Transport for knife rests will be arranged through

嫌疑分子
2. 未被起诉的嫌疑分子将由分区主管警官酌情释放。

运输拒马（knife rests）的车辆将通过总部安排，于8月8日晚9时抵达。

Emergency period August 9 - 14, 1940

The Deputy Commissioner in Charge has
approved the modified scheme of barrier searches as
discussed on July 26, and intensive interval search
parties will commence at 6 p.m. August 5, instead
August 9, as last year.

Paragraphs Nos. 1 to 3 of the instructions
to be issued in due course will read as follows:-

SEARCH
PARTIES
1. Commencing from 6.00 P.M. August 5th, internal
Search Parties consisting of all available uni-
form officers and detectives will round up and
detain in Stations all known suspects, loiterers,
persons found in hotels, tea-shops, lodging
houses etc., who fail to give a satisfactory
account to the Police of their presence in the
Settlement. Station staffs will be assisted by
the Reserve Unit and other details to be
published later.

SUBJECTS
2. Suspects who are not charged will be released at
the discretion of Divisional Officers.

CURFEW
3. Curfew will be strictly enforced from August 5/6
until "stand-down" is ordered.

Please notify P.A.(Divisions) as soon as
possible what extra personnel will be required between
August 9 - 14.

It will probably be impossible to supply as
many members of Foreign Branch I and Chinese as for the
last Emergency Day.

With reference to the attached translation
of an article appearing in the Tairiku Shimpo dated
August 8th, 1940, regarding manoeuvres to be held by
the Japanese Naval Landing Party on August 13th, I
have to state that as reported by the newspaper the
manoeuvres will be carried out in the area covering
Kwung Chun Road (廣中路), Chapei, commencing from
10.30 a.m. August 13th and lasting for about one
hour. Arms of various calibre will be used in the
sham-fight and blank ammunition will be used, but
aircrafts will not be used.

Manoeuvres of a defensive nature will also
take place within an area covered by the Soochow
Creek (Chapei side) from Ziang Ying Road (翔殷路) to
the former central mint at Ichang Road Bridge. Then
an area West of the Sawgin Creek in Chapei. All
that area is outside the Settlement limits. The
manoeuvres will commence at 10 p.m. August 10 and
continue during the morning of August 11, when blank
ammunition will be used.

The public is warned not to be alarmed by
the firing.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE / 11 AUG 1940）

D. Kamashita

鉴于附件中译自1940年8月8日《大陆新报》的一篇文章，内容涉及日本海军陆战队将于8月13日举行的演习，兹声明如下：据该报报道，演习将于8月13日上午10时30分开始，在闸北广中路一带地区进行，持续约一小时。假战斗中将使用各种口径的武器，并使用空包弹，但不使用飞机。

防御性质的演习也将在苏州河（闸北侧）从翔殷路至宜昌路桥的原中央造币厂这一覆盖区域内进行。随后是在闸北虬江以西的区域。所有这些区域均在租界界限之外。演习将于8月10日晚上10时开始，并持续至8月11日上午，期间将使用空包弹。

特此警告公众勿因枪声而惊慌。

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

JAPANESE NAVAL LANDING PARTY TO CARRY
OUT WAR-GAMES IN CHAPEI ON AUGUST 13

At 10.30 a.m. August 13, the third anniver-
sary of the outbreak of the Shanghai Incident, the Japanese
Special Naval Landing Party will carry out a sham-fight.
This will recall to our minds the conditions prevailing
at the time of the outbreak of the Incident. The operations
will be staged in the vicinity of Kwung Chung Road (廣中路)
in Chapei.

A rehearsal will take place at a late
hour on the night of August 10 and will continue until noon
the following day.

The Naval Authorities are providing stands
for the general public to watch the games.

《大陆新报》

日本海军陆战队将于8月13日在闸北举行军事演习

8月13日上午10时30分，即上海事变爆发三周年之际，日本特别海军陆战队将进行一场假战斗。这将使我们回想起事变爆发时的局势。行动将在闸北广中路附近上演。

预演将于8月10日深夜进行，并持续至次日中午。

海军当局将为公众提供看台以观看演习。

In connection with my previous report, dated
July 2nd, regarding the functions scheduled to take
place on July 7th and August 13th, the following
particulars concerning items No. 5 and 6, among the
functions to be held on August 13th, were approved
at the meeting, which took place in the Nippon
Club, Boone Road, on August 3rd:-

No. 5. A radio drama entitled "Recall of the
outbreak of local hostilities" will be broadcasted
from the Daito Radio Station at 8.40 p.m. August 12.
A speech by Mr. S. Mimura, vice-president
of the Amalgamated Federation of Japanese Street
Unions, on the subject of "Remember the outbreak of
local hostilities" and a Japanese musical item
entitled "Gallant Naval Landing Party" will be
broadcasted from the same station at 8.40 p.m.
August 13th.

No. 6. "An evening of lecture, music and cinema"
will be observed at the Chun Hwa Theatre, North
Szechuen Road, beginning at 7 p.m. August 13th,
sponsored by the Japanese Residents' Corporation
and the local Navy Association. The programme is
as follows:-

1. Opening speech by lieut.-Commander Asada.
2. A lecture by Commander Nishibayashi.
3. Music played by a Japanese naval band.
4. Cinema films entitled "Record of local
hostilities" and "the Yangtse River".

D. S. Hamashita

第5项. 一部题为“回忆当地敌对行动爆发”的广播剧将于8月12日晚上8时40分由大东电台播出。
日本街道工会联合会副主席 S. Mimura 先生将以“铭记当地敌对行动爆发”为题发表演讲，随后播出一首题为“英勇的海军陆战队”的日本音乐节目，上述内容将于8月13日晚上8时40分由同一电台播出。

1. 浅田少校致开幕词。
2. 西林指挥官发表演讲。
3. 日本海军乐队演奏音乐。
4. 放映题为“当地敌对行动记录”和“长江”的电影。
